wish_topics.evidence_span: Eradicate poverty: Ensuring everyone has access to basic needs like food, shelter, healthcare, and education
Promote equality and combat discrimination: Eliminating all forms of discrimination based on race, gender, sexuality, religion, and other factors
Combat climate change: Taking significant steps to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, protect natural habitats, and promote renewable energy
Improve global health: Addressing global health issues such as pandemics, access to essential medicines, and improving overall health outcomes
Foster peace and understanding: Encouraging open communication, cooperation, and diplomacy among nations could lead to less conflict
Increase access to education: Ensuring that everyone has access to quality education
Promote sustainability: Encouraging responsible consumption and production patterns, protecting biodiversity, and preserving natural resources
Protect human rights: Upholding and respecting the rights of every individual
Enhance environmental protection: Implementing policies to protect ecosystems, prevent pollution, and reduce waste
Foster empathy and compassion: Encouraging empathy and kindness towards others
